topic: Shared final-egress encoding and phase-aware source producer capture
sourceTrace: Final-egress publication encoded14 fields at the callback tail, separate from entry/sweep lane encoding. The old private capture required13 lanes, so egress could not produce a capture.

The existing executor creates distinct original egressStartedServer and egressDeadlineServer clocks; the latter can outlive the sweep hard deadline. Capture must preserve that original finite egress window, not grant a replacement window.

Egress progress rows are initialized with seven original fields at transition or assignment before native doMove. Missing rows previously produced sentinel/fallback values in publication rather than a valid transferable progress record.
implementation: BuildingProducerContext verifies actual private job/brain identity, original producerOwner, parent CLEAR operation objective/generation/epoch, exact visit context, unchanged building transform and original phase deadline. LIVE requires current locality and uncancelled producer; FROZEN requires actual loss and the existing LOCALITY_CHANGE callback fence before pointer/epoch retirement. A completed callback flag is not all-writer quiescence.

BuildingLaneJournal EXPORT/FROZEN uses that shared producer predicate; SAVE/ADOPT/CHECK phase admission remains unchanged. Entry/sweep still require their original hard deadline; egress capture uses the existing original egressDeadlineServer. No deadline changed.

BuildingEgressJournal purely serializes the existing version5 fourteen-field journal. Actual live publication and outgoing capture share it. At most eight total assigned/pending actors, eight progress rows,64 movement entries and four exit-use counters; original retry, pending plan counts, timestamps, legs, checkpoints and motion positions retained. Nested vectors/context are copied independently.

Require one exact seven-field progress record per current assignment, typed finite nonnegative distances/clocks, retries0/1, pending attempts0/1/2, unique actor assignments and original-clock bounds. Missing/malformed state refuses instead of substituting a new budget or observation.

Outer machine-private capture becomes version5/twelve fields: [5,producerOwner,clearGeneration,ownerEpoch,operationGeneration,capturedServerTime,originalHardDeadline,lanes,stageJournal,rooms,phase,egress]. ENTRY/SWEEP carries13 lanes and empty egress; EGRESS carries empty lanes and14-field egress. Both retain valid exterior and per-actor room histories. No receiver consumes this source record.

Shared producer admission rejects both a finished brain and an already-finished private job, matching the existing live egress publication exclusion. Job terminal marking occurs before the final brain status write; no scheduler race is assumed.
cost: Existing egress changed-only public write cadence and same8x8 progress association bound; added validation and deep vector copies. Shared source context adds bounded original identity/transform checks during export/loss; entry/sweep FROZEN rechecks through the lane serializer. No worker, scan, timer, request or new public channel. Actual frame-time effect and5/10budget unmeasured.
remaining: REPLAN capture remains unsupported by the existing lane schema; do not count all clearance phases complete.
Follow-through, early-exit/reserve state, original deleted actor identity, actor motion/settings, interruption and retirement domains still need a coherent source contract.
No authenticated producer registration/final seal/request replay or actual incoming native-ready aggregation. No proof that all original callbacks/workers are quiescent.
Physical flow, locality/HC/JIP/Zeus repeated use, balance and performance remain unverified. Audits paused.
